polycraft.config.title: PolyCraft Configuration
polycraft.config.option.detectOverlappin: When enabled, recipes that the same ingredients can satisfy count as a conflict even if their ingredient lists differ, such as a tag recipe and a recipe for one specific item. This can offer more choices. (Default: false)
polycraft.config.option.enabledRecipeTyp: If this list has entries, PolyCraft only handles these recipe types. Entries are a recipe type id such as minecraft:smelting, or modid:* for every type from a mod. Leave empty to handle every type. (Default: empty)
polycraft.config.option.disabledRecipeTy: PolyCraft ignores these recipe types. Entries work like the enabled list, and this list wins if a type is in both. (Default: empty)
polycraft.config.option.visibleOptions.d: How many recipe choices the list shows at once before it gets scroll arrows. (Default: 6)
polycraft.config.option.showConflictBadg: Shows how many recipes you can choose from on the corner of the recipe button. (Default: true)
When enabled, each player's recipe choices are saved with the world. When disabled, choices aren't saved and the pack's defaults apply each time. (Default: true)
polycraft.config.option.debugLogging.des: Writes extra detail about the recipe conflicts it finds to the game log. (Default: false)
polycraft.command.conflicts.none_for_mod: PolyCraft found no recipe conflicts involving %s.
polycraft.command.conflicts.more: ...and %s more. Use /polycraft export to write them all to a file.
